title: Security Middleware (Helmet, CORS, Compression)
goal: Implement production-grade security middleware including Helmet security headers, CORS whitelist validation, and response compression.

sub_tasks.title: Add Helmet Security Headers
sub_tasks.output: Configured helmet middleware with Content Security Policy, cross-origin resource policy set to cross-origin

sub_tasks.title: Implement CORS Whitelist
sub_tasks.output: Added CORS middleware with origin validation against ALLOWED_ORIGINS environment variable, rejects unauthorized origins

sub_tasks.title: Add Response Compression
sub_tasks.output: Integrated compression middleware to reduce response payload size for improved performance

acceptance_criteria: Helmet security headers configured and active
CORS whitelist enforces allowed origins from environment variable
Response compression enabled for all routes
result_summary: Production-grade security middleware implemented. Helmet provides comprehensive security headers including CSP, CORS validates requests against ALLOWED_ORIGINS whitelist, and compression middleware reduces bandwidth usage. All security best practices followed.
